title: A bill to amend title 36, United States Code, to designate the bald eagle as the national bird.
official_summary: This act designates the bald eagle (Haliaeetus leucocephalus) as the national bird.

summary.headline: This law officially names the bald eagle as the national bird of the United States.
summary.what_it_does: This law adds the bald eagle (Haliaeetus leucocephalus) to the part of federal law that lists national symbols, making it the official national bird.
